run_pairwise_bleu: run the scoring script to compute pairwise BLEU scores over candidate translation hypotheses
run_multi_ref_bleu: run the scoring script to compute multi-reference BLEU scores against reference translations
run_intra_ref_bleu: run the scoring script to compute intra-reference pairwise and leave-one-out BLEU scores
run_merge_outputs: run the scoring script with --output to merge source, target, and hypothesis outputs into a file
run_corpus_bleu: run the scoring script to compute corpus-level BLEU scores using sacrebleu with no tokenization
